'''Kalisch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] who served in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he served on the [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] ''[[Paramount]]'' and was one of the commanders who fought in the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|Battle of Sebaddon]].
